description: This pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," visually represents the distribution of token routing across different components within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model framework. The chart is composed of three distinct slices: a large green segment labeled "LOCAL," which constitutes the vast majority of the distribution; a smaller red segment labeled "LLM" with a value of 3.9%; and a very small blue segment labeled "EDGE_P2P" with a value of 1.6%. The chart includes percentage labels directly on the corresponding slices for the "LLM" and "EDGE_P2P" categories, while the "LOCAL" category does not have a percentage label shown. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with "LOCAL" occupying the largest portion, followed by "LLM," and then "EDGE_P2P." There is no legend provided in the chart, and no visual emphasis such as an exploded slice is applied to any particular segment.
